Five functions in `lib/` call `req.get` / `req.header`. I found them by searching `lib/` for every `.get(` and `.header(` call and keeping only the ones made on a request object.

- `lib/request.js:213` — `req.range` calls `this.get('Range')`
- `lib/request.js:318` — the `protocol` getter calls `this.get('X-Forwarded-Proto')`
- `lib/request.js:429` and `:432` — the `hostname` getter calls `this.get('X-Forwarded-Host')` and `this.get('Host')`
- `lib/request.js:507` — the `xhr` getter calls `this.get('X-Requested-With')`
- `lib/response.js:912` — `res.location` calls `this.req.get('Referrer')`

Calls I left out:
- In `lib/response.js`, `this.get(...)` means `res.get`.
- `app.get(...)` calls look up app settings.
- The `fresh` getter calls `res.get`, not `req.get`.
- Nothing in `lib/` calls `.header(` on a request.
